bib.title: BARTScore: Evaluating Generated Text as Text Generation

question: Can the quality of generated text be evaluated unsupervised as the likelihood of generating it (or the reference/source) under a pre-trained seq2seq model?
hypothesis: Models trained to convert generated text to/from a reference or source will assign higher scores when the generated text is better.
contributions: Formulate evaluation of generated text as text generation with BART (BARTScore), with four directions (s->h, r->h, h->r, r<->h)
Variants via prompting and fine-tuning on CNNDM and ParaBank2
Meta-evaluation on 16 datasets and 7 perspectives; best in 16 of 22 settings

method.summary: BARTScore is the weighted sum of token log-probabilities of a target text y given a source text x under BART, with uniform weights. Direction (s->h, h->r, r->h, F) is picked per perspective; variants fine-tune BART on CNNDM then ParaBank2 or add prompts to the decoder input. Metrics are meta-evaluated by correlation with human judgments on MT, summarization, factuality and data-to-text datasets.
method.task: Unsupervised evaluation metric for text generation (MT, summarization, data-to-text)

datasets.name: WMT19 metrics DARR
datasets.size: 7 language pairs (de-en, fi-en, gu-en, kk-en, lt-en, ru-en, zh-en)
datasets.source: WMT19 metrics shared task (Ma et al. 2019)

datasets.name: WMT18
datasets.size: used to search one best prompt

datasets.name: SummEval
datasets.source: Fabbri et al. 2021; CNNDM summaries, expert and crowd annotation

datasets.name: Rank19
datasets.size: 373 triples (source sentence, one correct and one incorrect summary sentence)

datasets.name: CNNDM
datasets.size: BART already fine-tuned, off-the-shelf from Huggingface

other.note: size of BART variant not stated in the paper
tried as alternative backbones, Appendix A.2

training.objective: fine-tuning of BART on ParaBank2 paraphrase pairs (generation); BARTScore itself needs no training

other.cnn_step: CNNDM-fine-tuned BART taken off the shelf from Huggingface Transformers

inference.samples: deterministic scoring; no seeds or repeats reported
inference.prompting: Prompt prefixed to decoder input (target) or appended to source; for summarization and data-to-text all prompts in the set are averaged (Eq. 3); for MT a single prompt 'Such as' picked on WMT18

parameters.token_weights: uniform (w_t equal); IDF, stop-word-ignoring and prior-probability weighting tried and did not beat uniform
parameters.directions: h->r for REALSumm (pyramid recall); s->h for linguistic quality, factuality; F score (r<->h) for MT and data-to-text
parameters.prompt_set_size: 70 prompts for s->h (seed 'in summary'), 34 for h<->r (seed 'in other words'), paraphrases from wordhippo.com
parameters.prompt_combination: mean over prompts of length-normalised log-prob (Eq. 3)

metrics.name: Kendall's Tau
metrics.definition: ordinal association between metric and human scores (WMT19)

metrics.name: Accuracy
metrics.definition: percentage of correct rankings between factual and non-factual texts (Rank19)

eval.protocol: Correlation with human judgments; bootstrapping pairwise significance test (p<0.05); official code for each baseline; dagger = beats other unsupervised metrics excluding BARTScore variants, double dagger = beats all unsupervised incl. variants

availability.data: public meta-evaluation datasets; leaderboard on ExplainaBoard

prompts.purpose: example from the full prompt sets (70 s->h and 34 h<->r, all in Appendix Table 9)

Almost all prompts help semantic overlap perspectives, few help factuality, linguistic quality unpredictable
T5 and PEGASUS give no improvement over BART on WMT19
results.setup: BART vanilla de-en; T5-base 0.170, PEGASUS-large 0.124; BART-cnn 0.190 vs T5-base-cnn 0.177
results.note: Mixed: T5-base beats vanilla BART on de-en, but the paper states no improvements were seen overall

limits: Prompts only help semantic-overlap perspectives; factuality and linguistic quality show inconsistent or negative effects (4.4.2, 5)
Fine-tuning on NeR18 did not help; dataset has only 7 easily distinguished systems
Prompts hand-built from synonyms; searched discrete prompts did worse (footnote 4)
Prompt for MT chosen on WMT18 dev only; no seeds or variance reported
Model size of BART not stated
Predates LLM-as-judge methods; correlation with human labels only

code.snippet: BARTSCORE = sum_{t=1}^{m} w_t log p(y_t | y_<t, x, theta)
BARTSCORE-PROMPT = (1/n) sum_{i=1}^{n} (1/m_i) sum_{t=1}^{m_i} log p([y:z_i]_t | [y:z_i]_<t, x, theta)
